annotations.title: Read the space around a node

description:
Read the clearance around one 3D node in 26 directions: what blocks each side and how far, contact, grounding and nearby objects. Changes nothing. Use it before and after placing.
Guide: summer_docs_read {"id":"tool/starcast"}

collideWithAreas.description: Include Area3D objects as well as physics bodies.

collisionMask.description: Godot 3D physics layer mask queried by rays, shape contacts/overlaps, and nearby-collider scans.

detail.description: summary: compact placement report (at most 5 KB). full: adds bounded hit geometry, an objects table, and nearby lists (at most 12 KB; the engine downgrades to summary rather than exceed it).

directionSpace.description: Cast along world axes, or along the subject's orthonormalized local axes when 'front', 'side', or 'up' mean the rotated subject's own orientation.

margin.description: Tolerance for exact-geometry physics shape intersection queries; touching and candidates within this margin are reported as contact_or_overlap.

maxDistance.description: Maximum outward cast distance in scene units.

maxHitsPerDirection.description: Maximum physics hits and visual AABB hits retained for each direction.

maxResults.description: Maximum retained contact/overlap and nearby entries per evidence channel.

nearbyRadius.description: Maximum gap from the subject bounds for the nearby-object lists (full detail).

path.description: Exact Node3D path relative to the scene root, e.g. './World/Crate'.

scenePath.description: Exact scene containing the subject, e.g. 'res://levels/level1.tscn'.

name: summer_starcast
